cards.lore: They say it's a partnership. A tick also calls the dog a partner.
cards.power: TAKE half of target player's resource tokens. You own their merch, touring, and soul.

cards.lore: I coulda been a contender! Instead, I'm a tax write-off.
cards.power: GAIN +2 Hype, but cannot read card text for the next 3 turns.

cards.lore: Don't worry about the fine print, kid. It's just standard boilerplate for 'indentured servitude'.
cards.power: FORCE a player to re-roll. If they fail, you keep their dice.

cards.lore: Hollywood Accounting: Where a billion dollars in profit is technically a loss.
cards.power: NEGATE any 'Success' roll. The label recoups expenses first.

cards.lore: Screw the rules, I have money! It's not bribery if we call it 'promotional support'.
cards.power: SPEND 5 Coin to force your song to the top of the playlist.

cards.lore: An industry plant with roots in the boardroom. Born on third base, thinks they hit a triple.
cards.power: START the game on Level 3. Talent is optional; lineage is mandatory.

cards.lore: Manufactured buzz for a disposable generation. Trending today, deleted tomorrow.
cards.power: COPY the last played effect. Follow the leader into the abyss.

cards.lore: Authenticity theft. You provide the face, we provide the feelings.
cards.power: STEAL the credit for another player's success roll.

cards.lore: I don't hear a single. Can you make it sound more like that other song everyone likes?
cards.power: CHANGE the genre of any card in play to 'Pop'.

cards.lore: We pivoted to appeal to males 18-34, so your ballad is now a truck commercial.
cards.power: DISCARD your hand and draw new cards until the demographic approves.

cards.lore: The Scorpion Algorithm: Optimizing art until it is perfectly flat and universally tolerated.
cards.power: PREDICT the next card. If it matches the formula, double its effect.

cards.lore: Forced Pivot. Yesterday you were Country, today you're EDM. Try to keep up.
cards.power: IGNORE penalties if you switch styles this turn.

cards.lore: My vision is the only vision. You're just the meat holding the instrument.
cards.power: DESTROY a card to 'improve' it. It comes back with lower stats.

cards.lore: Talent is a bug. Pitch correction is the feature.
cards.power: FIX a failed roll. The result is successful but artificial.

cards.lore: The nameless pro who actually played on your favorite album. No royalties, flat fee.
cards.power: SWAP this card in to take the damage for another player.

cards.lore: The label isn't saying "no." They're just saying "not in this lifetime."
cards.power: SKIP your turn. Repeat indefinitely until contract expires.

cards.lore: Killer vs. Filler. Two minutes of hooks, forty minutes of contractual obligation.
cards.power: SACRIFICE the rest of your hand to play this one card.

cards.lore: You hummed three notes from 1974. That'll be 100% of your publishing.
cards.power: BLOCK an opponent's action unless they pay you a royalty.

cards.lore: Brickwalled audio. If everything is loud, nothing is loud.
cards.power: OVERPOWER all other cards this turn. No dynamic range allowed.

cards.lore: You had 20 years to write the first album and six months to write the second.
cards.power: ROLL a D6. On 1-3, your career ends immediately.

cards.lore: Hotter and Sexier. It's not about the voice, it's about the view.
cards.power: GAIN Appeal, LOSE Dignity.

cards.lore: Lighter and Softer. Family-friendly content for the mass market.
cards.power: DISGUISE your true type. Opponents cannot target you this turn.

cards.lore: Kayfabe conflict. Nothing sells records like a beef manufactured by the same PR firm.
cards.power: GENERATE hype by attacking an ally. No actual damage dealt.

cards.lore: Darker and Edgier. When the teen pop sales dip, pivot to "mature" angst.
cards.power: INTIMIDATE weaker cards.

cards.lore: Disposable Youth. Squeeze the juice, discard the rind.
cards.power: EXHAUST this card to gain quick cash. Discard after 3 turns.

cards.lore: Chasing Dads. We're huge with the mid-life crisis market.
cards.power: EXPAND your reach. Collect tokens from players outside your genre.

cards.lore: From protest songs to insurance jingles. Money, dear boy.
cards.power: GAIN massive resources, but your 'Credibility' score drops to zero.

cards.lore: They think they know you. They think they own you.
cards.power: BIND a fan to your card. They cannot leave play but drain your energy.
AUTOMATIC SUCCESS on performance rolls. Fails if Milli Vanilli rules apply. It's "augmenting the live experience".

cards.lore: There is no such thing as an accidental tape leak. Everything is a rollout.
cards.power: REVEAL an opponent's hand. Gain hype from the exposure.

cards.lore: Safe Politics. Corporate activism that costs nothing and changes nothing.
cards.power: DEFLECT criticism. You are immune to 'Cancel Culture' cards this turn.

cards.lore: PR Crisis Team. Burying the bodies so the show can go on.
cards.power: REMOVE a 'Controversy' token from your artist.

cards.lore: Band Fever. In Nebraska.
cards.power: TRAP all band members. Tension increases by +1 every turn.

cards.lore: No brown M&Ms. It's not about the candy, it's about control.
cards.power: DEMAND specific resources. If not met, cancel the gig.

cards.lore: I'm with the band. Or at least, I'm with the laminate.
cards.power: DISTRACT a player. They miss their cue.

cards.lore: Babysitter. Keeping the talent alive, sober-ish, and on schedule.
cards.power: FORCE a player to perform an action they don't want to do.

cards.lore: The Ego Clash. Code for 'we can't be in the same room without lawyers'.
cards.power: SPLIT the party. Half the resources are lost in the divorce.

cards.lore: LSD: Lead Singer Disease. The belief that the microphone is the only instrument that matters.
cards.power: ABSORB all buffs meant for the group.

cards.lore: Disposable Members. The band is a brand; the people are just spare parts.
cards.power: REPLACE a member instantly. Stats reset to zero.

cards.lore: Vice and Excess. Coping mechanisms that become structural, load-bearing walls.
cards.power: GAIN a temporary boost, then suffer a permanent penalty next turn.

cards.lore: Pay to Play. Subsidizing the headliner's retirement fund for "exposure".
cards.power: PAY to enter the game. You are technically on the tour, but no one is watching.

cards.lore: Promoter Failure. The echo is your only fan.
cards.power: MORALE CHECK. If failed, lose the will to continue.

cards.lore: Act of God. Or maybe just low ticket sales. We'll never know.
cards.power: END the turn immediately. No resources collected.

cards.lore: They wanted the encore, but there was nothing left to give.
cards.power: REMOVE artist from play for "Exhaustion".

cards.lore: The Shelf. The best album you'll never hear because the label folded.
cards.power: CANNOT be played. Exists only as a rumor.

cards.lore: The Leak. If the label won't release it, the internet will.
cards.power: BYPASS copyright. Play a card from the discard pile.

cards.lore: Contractual Obligation. Two new songs, ten old ones, one desperate cash grab.
cards.power: REPLAY old cards with no new effect. Fulfill contract conditions.

cards.lore: Lazy Cash-grab. Dubstep version? Acoustic version? Lo-fi beats to study to?
cards.power: RESHUFFLE the deck. The song is the same, but worse.

cards.lore: The Bitter Mentor. He's seen it all, and he hates it all.
cards.power: DEBUFF younger artists. "Back in my day..."

cards.lore: The Pension Fund. We hate each other, but we love the paycheck.
cards.power: REVIVE a dead band. Collect triple coin, but lose all artistic integrity.

cards.lore: Grave Robbery. Tupac didn't sign up for this.
cards.power: IMMORTALITY. The artist cannot die because they are already dead.

cards.lore: Revisionist History. The drug addiction was a "struggle", and the greed was "ambition".
cards.power: REWRITE history. Remove all negative status effects from the past.

cards.lore: 50/50 Split. We might not be rich, but we own the masters.
cards.power: IMMUNE to Corporate effects. Gain less money, keep more soul.

cards.lore: DIY Spirit. Cut, paste, copy, distribute. No permission asked.
cards.power: SPREAD the truth. Counter a 'PR Scandal' card.

cards.lore: Actual Politics. Not a fashion statement. A threat.
cards.power: ATTACK the game structure itself.

cards.lore: Raw Soul. It sounds terrible. It sounds perfect.
cards.power: RESET the game to zero. Start over, but this time, do it yourself.
